verdict.rationale: YPOG publishes a dedicated early-stage financing briefing on how seedstrapping affects CLAs, SAFEs and ASAs, covering valuation cap and governance risks and when a priced round is better. It also states that these instruments are the default for European pre-seed and seed. This sits alongside a stated transactions practice advising companies 'from inception to exit' and a venture-deals webinar on market-standard terms. Missing for 10: downloadable SAFE/CLA forms or templates, documented pre-seed/seed convertible deal track record, independent corroboration of depth beyond a single explainer.
